title: Bing Places for Business skill roadmap

beginner.title: Get started with Bing Places for Business
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Bing Places for Business, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up and connect
beginner.outcome: You can: connect Bing Places for Business to your accounts
beginner.practice: Connect your accounts and set up your profile

beginner.title: First campaign or post
beginner.outcome: You can: publish something that works
beginner.practice: Launch one small campaign or post series

intermediate.title: Measure what matters
intermediate.practice: Review results and choose one improvement

intermediate.title: Segment and personalise
intermediate.outcome: You can: send the right message to the right people
intermediate.practice: Build two segments and tailor a message

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Bing Places for Business
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Bing Places for Business distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Bing Places for Business
expert.outcome: You can: use Bing Places for Business's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Automate and optimise
expert.outcome: You can: run marketing that improves over time
expert.practice: Set up one automation and one test

expert.title: Integrate Bing Places for Business into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Bing Places for Business with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Bing Places for Business to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Bing Places for Business well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Bing Places for Business" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
